title: Choose the look of the SaveBytes website
question: Light, minimal, one blue. The roll dealt the Medicine Carton. Keep it, take the pick or the standard, or re-roll.

options.label: Medicine Carton
options.lineage: printed pharmacy cartons: a front panel and side panels of small print
options.thesis: Each page is one carton: a big front panel for the name, a side panel for the facts.
options.viewport: A grey front panel holds the headline at full size; a white side panel lists what we make, the product, where we are, and Get in touch.
options.risk: Could read as a pharma brand if the panels look like real packaging.

raised.raise: No rules and no boxes: panels are tone steps, never outlines.
One typeface family; hierarchy is size and weight only.
Every edge sits on one 8px module.
Only one blue thing per screen: the action.

options.label: Hospital Signage
options.thesis: The site is a clear sign: a big statement, then a directory of where to go.
options.viewport: A large two-line headline and one line under it; below, a directory of three panels with arrows: SaveBytes Health, About, Contact.
options.risk: Familiar: close to what many calm product sites ship.

options.label: Cracktro Scroller
options.thesis: Bitmap text riding over a drifting black void.
options.viewport: One line of ivory text on black with drifting dust.
options.case: Loses both axes: dark, retro and loud; clinics would not see themselves in it.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.thesis: The site as a terminal transcript.
options.case: Loses both axes: reads as developer tooling, not clinic software.
options.kept: One typeface family, hierarchy by size and weight.

options.label: Hand-bent Neon
options.thesis: A word lit as one glass stroke in a dark room.
options.viewport: A cobalt neon word glowing in the dark.
options.case: Loses both axes: glow and darkness are the opposite of quiet.

options.label: Brick Instructions
options.thesis: Numbered exploded steps on sky-blue pages.
options.viewport: A big step numeral and pieces clicking into place.
options.case: Loses both axes: playful and numbered, and you asked for no numbering.

options.label: Vinyl Car Wrap
options.thesis: Art spread across body panels with sponsor strips.
options.viewport: A huge illustration broken across panels.
options.case: Loses both axes: loud and image-led.
options.kept: Show the one picture large, never as a thumbnail.

options.label: Memphis Showroom
options.thesis: Clashing candy shapes and squiggle patterns.
options.case: Loses both axes: busy, many colours.
options.risk: The opposite of what you asked.
options.kept: States change by weight or shape, never by colour alone.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: An Apple-style company page: centred headline, one action, one product tile.
canonCard.viewport: A centred two-line headline, one line under it, Get in touch and a link, then a large grey tile for SaveBytes Health.
canonCard.risk: Looks like many other calm product sites by design.
